body.message:
Hello,

I’m currently looking for a 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment in Downtown Dubai.

My preferred area is around the Dubai Opera, ideally in residences such as Forte Tower 1 or Forte Tower 2, or similar high-quality buildings. I’m looking for a modern, clean residence with good amenities, especially a swimming pool.

My preference is to rent for one full year, but I would like to pay the rent on a monthly basis rather than with post-dated cheques.

If you have any properties matching these criteria, I’d be happy to receive the details and arrange viewings.

Thank you, and I look forward to hearing from you.
